name: Supine march
summary: Lying with knees bent, brace and lift one foot off the floor, lower, then the other.
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, side-on to the phone at floor level. Brace the stomach and lift one foot until the knee is over the hip, lower with control, then the other.
brief: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Brace the stomach and lift one foot until the knee is over the hip, lower with control, then the other.
why: From the side the near thigh rises toward vertical on every lift, so reps are counted. The pelvis rocking is not measured.
progression: Hold the top; progress to dead bug.
contraindications: Back pain as the foot lifts.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Pelvis rocking
faults.tip: Brace before the foot lifts; if the pelvis rocks, lift the foot less.

faults.label: Back arching as the foot lifts
faults.tip: If the back lifts, the leg is going too high or too fast. Smaller and slower.

faults.label: Holding the breath
faults.tip: Exhale on the lift and the brace stays on without straining.

faults.label: Marching quickly
faults.tip: Speed lets momentum swing the leg. Slow marching is what recruits the deep abdominals.

points.t: Knee lifts over the hip, foot relaxed.
